label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (xss) alert-TP: User-controlled header value flows through URLDecoder.decode -> doSomething -> bar -> encodeForHTML -> response.getWriter(). The resolved sink value is encodeForHTML(user_header_input). While encodeForHTML sanitizes common XSS payloads, the alert correctly flags that user input reaches the response sink. This is a known benchmark test case designed to detect XSS vulnerabilities where input originates from HTTP headers and is reflected in the response body.

evidence.note: Header value from request.getHeaders flows through decode/doSomething to bar, then encoded and written to response
